missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Болезнь' is the nominative subject, an -ость-type feminine noun. 'Серьёзной' is the instrumental predicate after 'оказалась', which agrees in feminine gender.

Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Болезнь' is the accusative object of 'вылечил'; this feminine soft-sign noun looks identical in the nominative and accusative singular. 'Врач' is the nominative subject.

missions.phrase: Причина болезни до сих пор неясна.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 'Болезни' is the genitive form showing the cause of what. 'Причина' is the nominative subject, and 'неясна' is the short-form predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative after сдаться. 'Болезни' is in the dative case as what he did not surrender to. 'Не сдался' is the negated past verb agreeing in masculine gender.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after с. 'Болезнью' is the instrumental form required by 'с' to express what he fought against. 'Долго' adds duration, and 'боролся' is the masculine past verb.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after о. 'О болезни' uses the prepositional 'болезни' to name the topic. 'Новой' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'врачи' is the nominative plural subject.

Strategic focus: Prepositional after при. 'Болезни' is the prepositional form after 'при' meaning during illness. 'Покой' is the nominative subject, and 'нужен' is the short-form predicate agreeing with it.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Болезни' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'опасны' is the short-form plural predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive after от. 'Болезни' is in the genitive case required by 'от' to express the cause of death. 'Тяжёлой' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after бояться. 'Болезней' is the genitive plural form required by 'бояться'. 'Этих' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'мы должны' frames the obligation.
